stem: Two Voltmarkt stores each have a stockout rate of 5% on TVs in October. In store A the empty days were on its 3 bestselling models; in store B they were on models that sell about one unit a month. Which statement is right?

options.text: The stores lost about the same sales, because their stockout rates are equal
Store A probably lost more sales, since its bestsellers were the ones empty
Store B's rate is wrong, because slow sellers cannot run out of stock
Store A's rate should be higher, because bestsellers weigh more in the rate
